description: Public JSON Schema contract for the authored documents of a connector package: where each sits, read from the connector's own directory (the one holding `definition/`), and the published schema it is written against. It holds locations only; each document's shape is the schema it points at. Other files a package carries are outside this schema. Source of truth: analitiq.contracts.connector_package.ConnectorPackage (Pydantic).
title: Analitiq Connector Package
